about: Archive items the PLAY library build leaves off, each with its reason (play/tools/library.js). From the PLAY auditor's read of the games-to-add shelf, 22 Nov 2026, under Bryan's rules: finished games only, adult games kept out entirely, gore, horror, gambling and the items marked his call held until he says. Remove a line to let a game back in; the next library build applies it.
